description: This file defines the CheckoutScreen widget for a Flutter-based mobile app. It provides UI for selecting fulfillment options (pickup, delivery, dine-in), payment methods (wallet, card, cash), entering delivery address if applicable, and a button to place an order. The widget interacts with providers for cart management, order processing, and localization.

classes.name: CheckoutScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the checkout process, including fulfillment and payment options, and placing orders.

classes.name: _CheckoutScreenState
classes.description: State class for CheckoutScreen, maintaining local state such as selected fulfillment and payment methods, and handling UI rendering.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the checkout screen, including fulfillment choices, payment options, address input, and the pay button.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the address text controller when the widget is removed.
